headline: Copper Rises 1.89 Percent to $5.43 as Industrial Metals Take the Bid
narrative: Copper rose 1.89 percent to $5.43, money moving into the industrial-metals pipe. Oil rose 1.47 percent to $84.91, and the energy pipe took the bid with copper. Bitcoin rose 1.37335 percent to 61k, while the S&P 500 eased 0.25 percent to 7,182.78.
